meta.description: Studio115 is an interior design studio working across residential and commercial spaces — design, build and styling handled by one team.

home.heroBody: Studio115 designs from the way people live and work. From homes to commercial spaces, one team owns design, construction and styling end to end.
home.servicesBody: Take the whole journey from brief to handover, or just the parts you need.
home.ctaBody: Leave a few details and we'll get back to you within two business days.

services.intro: The scope Studio115 covers. We combine these to fit the nature of each project.

about.title: Studio
about.intro: We make spaces that hold up in daily life, not just in photos.
about.body: Every project starts with an on-site survey and a conversation about how you live. We resolve it in drawings and 3D before breaking ground, and a designer stays on site through construction. (Placeholder body.)

one.title: Honest estimates
one.body: Line-item quotes, kept open. Any change in cost is agreed before the work.

two.title: One team, accountable
two.body: Design and build are not split. You have a single point of contact.

three.title: Finishes that last
three.body: We prioritise the quality of the work you can't see.

contact.title: Start a project
contact.intro: The space type, a rough budget and a timeline are enough to begin. A designer will follow up after we review it.
